gloss: idiom from a historical story; historical proverb

definitions.gloss: idiom derived from a historical story; proverb originating from classical Chinese or Japanese history
definitions.explanation: A fixed expression or saying that originated from a specific historical episode or classical text, typically from ancient Chinese literature. Studied as part of Japanese language education.

examples.japanese: {故事成語|こじせいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I look up a historical idiom.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{故事成語|こじせいご}だ。
examples.english: 'Contradiction' (矛盾) is a famous historical idiom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{故事成語|こじせいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: We learned the origins of historical idioms in Japanese class.

notes:
USAGE:
A term used in Japanese language education. Many {故事成語|こじせいご} come from ancient Chinese texts (⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧). Common examples include ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧ (contradiction), ⟦{蛇足|だそく}→蛇足：15805_dasoku⟧ (something unnecessary), and {五十歩百歩|ごじっぽひゃっぽ} (pot calling the kettle black).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {故事成語|こじせいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧ (the origin of a historical idiom)
- {故事成語|こじせいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a historical idiom)
- {故事成語|こじせいご}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (dictionary of historical idioms)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧: four-character compound — fixed four-kanji expressions, some of which are also {故事成語|こじせいご}
- ⟦{諺|ことわざ}→諺：02765_kotowaza⟧: proverb — a broader category of traditional sayings
